fixesApplied.action: Changed left: 28 -> left: 11. Badge centre = 440 - XC = 108 design units; box centre = 111.5, i.e. ~3.5 design px RIGHT of the badge centre. Measured the original: caption content centre sits ~3.5 design px (~13 screen px) LEFT of the badge centre (start-side bias), so the faithful mirror is ~3.5 design px right. Verified on fa.f167: caption centre ~528 screen px vs badge centre ~512 px - visually centred lockup.
fixesApplied.why: The caption is part of the badge lockup; a faithful mirror must reproduce the original's sub-centre bias in the opposite direction, not amplify it.

fixesApplied.action: Replaced Latin identifiers with «م۱»-«م۴» (mem = منبع/source) via faDigits; added fs() scaling (x1.1) to the node label fontSize for the smaller Persian x-height.
fixesApplied.why: A Persian product names its sources in Persian; digits via faDigits keep Persian digit forms. Original rest positions, shrink stages and timings untouched - the Persian tags have the same 2-character footprint.

fixesApplied.action: Expanded the header with the exact mirror formula (path d M 462,y L 366,y C 254,y 226,YC 108,YC; pointAt x = 462 - sc on the lead-in and x = 440 - p.x on the cubic; rest-position threshold x <= 366; badge left: 440 - XC - 17) and the caption alignment decision; translated every remaining Chinese comment to English. No Chinese remains in the file.
fixesApplied.why: The header is the permanent record of the geometry mirroring; the reviewer must be able to re-derive every coordinate.

translations.reason: Concise, natural product language for the single-result payoff; three words map onto the same word-by-word darkening beats.
Reviewer-flagged: Latin identifiers inside an all-Persian diagram read as leftovers; «م» + Persian digit is natural Persian product wording with the same footprint.

rtlDecisions.what: Four source nodes and their bezier curves
rtlDecisions.action: Mirrored horizontally with the exact formula x' = 440 - x: path d becomes M 462,y L 366,y C 254,y 226,YC 108,YC; the arc-length pointAt returns x = 462 - sc on the straight lead-in and x = 440 - p.x on the cubic; the node rest-position search threshold flips from pointAt(...).x >= 74 to <= 366; badge left: 440 - XC - 17. Sources sit on the right and slide toward the badge on the left.
rtlDecisions.why: Source-to-result flow carries reading direction in this explanatory diagram. Nodes and blue packets ride the actual mirrored curves (verified f14/f30/f42/f48/f96).

rtlDecisions.action: Kept the original progress formulas, stagger (0.04 + i*0.045), durations and easing; the mirrored geometry makes the visible draw travel right-to-left and the erase retreat toward the right start edge.
rtlDecisions.why: The sweep direction carries the diagram's reading order; beats identical (verified f42 draw-on mid-flight, f145 erase tail on the badge's right, mirroring the orig tail on its left).

rtlDecisions.action: Persian digits via faDigits inside the tags; RTL glyphs, letterSpacing 0, label size fs()-scaled. Vertical top-to-bottom stacking kept.
rtlDecisions.why: Persian product wording; the vertical arrangement is physical layout, not reading order. Digits keep their numeric order inside the RTL tag via bidi.

rtlDecisions.action: Badge moved to the mirrored coordinate; star shape/orientation unchanged.
rtlDecisions.why: Badge location participates in the reading flow; the symmetric star is a physical mark.

rtlDecisions.what: Final caption lockup and word-color progression
rtlDecisions.action: «چهار منبع یکپارچه», box width 200, justifyContent center, left: 11 (centre 111.5 = badge centre 108 + 3.5 mirrored bias). Word-by-word darkening kept on the original beats, starting at the right-most word «چهار» (mirrors original starting at 'Four'). Logical marginInlineEnd between words; letterSpacing 0; lineHeight FA_LH.
rtlDecisions.why: Persian UI copy reads and emphasizes right-to-left; the caption belongs visually to the badge it names.

rtlDecisions.what: Canvas centering, vertical coordinates, circles, shadows, star
rtlDecisions.why: Symmetric or vertical composition and physical depth cues carry no RTL semantics.

verification.visualResult: Every checked frame pairs 1:1 with the original beat-for-beat; no unintended English/Chinese text on screen; Persian shaping correct (Persian digits, ی/ک forms).

lessons: When the original places a caption with a small deliberate off-centre bias inside a lockup, the mirror must reproduce the same magnitude of bias flipped to the other side, not a larger offset; measure the original render (or box math) before choosing the mirrored coordinate instead of eyeballing a round number.

Compact node tags are worth localizing even when they look like 'identifiers': Latin S1-S4 inside an otherwise all-Persian diagram reads as an untranslated leftover; Persian digit tags («م۱») keep the same 2-character footprint so no timing or geometry changes are needed.
grep -P with \x{...} ranges above the BMP fails on Git-Bash ('character value in \x{} too large'); use the [一-龥] range form to scan for leftover CJK comments.
